issues.t: Oil burning and fouled spark plugs (VCM)
issues.sym: A flashing or steady check engine light, misfire codes, a shaking engine, and oil disappearing between changes.
issues.why: Honda's cylinder-deactivation system (VCM) lets oil get past the piston rings in the cylinders that shut off, which burns oil and fouls spark plugs. A class-action settlement extended powertrain coverage on 2010-2012 V6 Crosstours; that coverage has now ended.
issues.next: Check the oil level often. Have misfire codes diagnosed; new plugs only help for a while if the rings are stuck.

issues.t: Rough running or rattle at steady cruise (VCM)
issues.sym: A rattle, shake or rough feel when cruising at a steady speed, sometimes with a blinking check engine light.
issues.why: Honda issued a bulletin for rough running and rattles while the V6 switches cylinders on and off at cruise.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Honda dealer about the bulletin. Spark plugs, engine mounts and software are the usual areas checked.

issues.t: Shudder at light throttle (2010 torque converter)
issues.sym: A shudder or vibration like driving over rumble strips at light throttle, usually between 20 and 50 mph.
issues.why: The torque converter's lock-up clutch can judder. Honda issued a transmission software update and warranty extensions, plus reimbursement for owners who paid for a torque converter.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer whether the software update and any extended coverage apply. A transmission fluid change sometimes helps.

issues.t: Torque converter judder at 20–60 mph
issues.sym: A shudder or rumbling while cruising gently between about 20 and 60 mph, as if driving on a rough road.
issues.why: Honda issued bulletins for the torque converter lock-up clutch judder on these years.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for the bulletin. A software update and fresh fluid are the usual first steps.

issues.t: Steering suddenly turns heavy (power steering unit failure)
issues.sym: The power steering warning light comes on and the steering becomes very hard to turn, sometimes without warning.
issues.why: The electric power steering control unit can fail. Honda extended coverage on this part for 2013-2014 Crosstours to 15 years with unlimited miles.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Ask about the extended EPS warranty; it may be free.

issues.t: Grinding rattle on cold start (VTC actuator)
issues.sym: A loud grinding or rattle for a second or two right after starting a cold engine.
issues.why: The variable valve timing (VTC) actuator on the camshaft can wear and rattle before oil pressure builds. Honda issued a bulletin to replace it.
issues.next: Have it checked, especially if the noise gets longer. Replacing the actuator usually ends the noise.

issues.t: Starter grinds or won't crank
issues.sym: A grinding or spinning noise when starting, or the engine not cranking at all.
issues.why: Honda investigated no-starts and grinding on these V6 models and issued a bulletin saying the starter's gear clearance was not ideal.
issues.next: Have the starter checked; ask a Honda dealer about the starter bulletin.

issues.t: Vibration at idle or while driving
issues.sym: Shaking felt in the seat, steering wheel or floor, especially at idle or while the engine changes cylinder modes.
issues.why: Owners of the 2011 and 2012 report vibration problems, often traced to worn engine mounts, which take extra strain from the V6's cylinder shutdown.
issues.next: Have the engine mounts inspected, especially the front and rear active mounts, and check for misfires.

issues.t: Brake pads wearing out early
issues.sym: Squealing or grinding brakes, or pads needing replacement as early as 20,000 miles.
issues.why: Owners of the 2011 and 2012 report unusually fast brake wear on this heavy car.
issues.next: Have the pads, rotors and slide pins checked, and choose good-quality pads when replacing.

issues.t: Clunk from the front suspension
issues.sym: A clunk or knock from the front when driving over bumps or turning at low speed.
issues.why: Honda issued a service bulletin for a front suspension clunk on these models.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected and ask the dealer about the bulletin.

issues.t: Low oil reading and check engine light from software
issues.sym: A check engine light or low dipstick reading even with no leak to be found.
issues.why: Honda issued a product update and bulletins for engine computer software that could cause these warnings.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer whether the software update has been done, and still check the oil level by hand.

issues.t: Touchscreen not responding or freezing
issues.sym: The lower touchscreen ignores taps, responds in the wrong spot, or freezes.
issues.why: Honda found debris getting into the gap around the screen bezel can cause it to misread touches.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about the touchscreen bulletin; cleaning the bezel gap often fixes it.

issues.t: Rubbing or groaning from the steering wheel
issues.sym: A rubbing or groaning sound from the steering wheel when turning it.
issues.why: Honda issued a bulletin for the driver airbag module rubbing inside the steering wheel.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about the bulletin; the fix is a quick adjustment.

issues.t: Paint peeling on White Diamond Pearl cars
issues.sym: Paint flaking or peeling, especially on cars painted White Diamond Pearl.
issues.why: Honda investigated paint peeling on 2014-2015 Crosstours in this color.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer whether any goodwill paint repair is available, and document the damage with photos.

issues.t: Front axle clicking or failing
issues.sym: Clicking when turning, vibration when accelerating, or grease spattered inside the wheel.
issues.why: Owners of the 2013 report front axles failing repeatedly.
issues.next: Have the axles and boots inspected. A torn boot caught early can sometimes be replaced alone.

issues.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing you notice day to day. The danger is in a crash.
issues.why: The Takata passenger airbag inflator can degrade after years of heat and humidity and burst when it deploys.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 16V-346, 17V-030, 18V-042, 18V-661 and 19V-502 and get the free replacement right away.

issues.t: Replacement passenger airbag may be installed wrong (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms. The airbag may not open correctly in a crash.
issues.why: Some passenger airbag modules replaced during earlier recall work may not have been installed correctly.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 17V-545, 18V-268 and 19V-378 so the dealer can inspect the installation.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not deploy as designed (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms; the problem would only show in a crash.
issues.why: Some passenger airbags in early Accord Crosstours were not assembled to specification.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 10V-402 and have the airbag replaced if it was never done.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag inflator out of spec (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms; the curtain airbags may not deploy in a crash.
issues.why: Some side curtain airbag inflators did not meet specifications.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 12V-030 and have the curtain airbags replaced.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag may not fully inflate (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms; the curtain airbags may not inflate properly in a crash.
issues.why: The inflator tube in some side curtain airbags, on cars built in fall 2014, was made incorrectly.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 14V-788 and get the free replacement.
